title: Integration of Rare Perks NFTs into a Cardano Based Ticketing Platform

ms.promise: Delivery of our solution design and estimated timeline documentation, containing full details of the solution, functionality, and implementation.
ms.criteria: This documentation will indicate sufficient information to understand the solution being delivered (i.e. tokengating our website) along with how it will be delivered.
ms.report:
We are resubmitting this PoA to provide a scaled down and final version of the original Solution Design. This Solution Design focuses only on the deliverables required for delivering our token-gated website portal proof of concept, rather than the entire Rare Perks NFT Collection which has ongoing development when it comes to the gamification as we have yet to launch. 
The issue with out first submission of PoA is that we expanded to much on the general collection. This correction is to ensure we focus only on what is required for the deliver of the POC for tokengated NFT tickets. This Project Catalyst proposal is not dependent on delivery of the 2024 Rare Evo NFT collection as the POC can utilize test NFTs. 
This Solution Design shows the general overview of the project, the solution areas that are relevant to the POC, a Roadmap and Timeline, User Stories for expected acceptance testing, and a breakdown of the Project Catalyst Milestones to indicate next steps on how to secure funding for integrating NFTs into our website and tickets. 
Please see the Solution Design in relation to the Project Catalyst deliverables for the token-gated POC for our NFT based ticketing for future events hosted by Rare Network (hosts of Rare Evo 2024):
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1bK2djXI8Giyompx6wbQHk_o35FoeFhTWzZK1kKsEGco/edit?usp=sharing

ms.promise: We will document a breakdown of the tokengating logic tree used for our customers to claim perks. Additionally, we will deliver a graphic design of the wallet connect and product claims experience via our website's shop.
ms.criteria: By viewing this documentation, readers will be able to understand the workflow and rules for utilizing the Rare Perks NFT to claim products.

ms.promise:
Cardano Users will be able to do the following;
・Purchase an NFT VIP ticket with fiat or ADA
・Be able to buy/sell/trade NFT ticket on the secondary market
・Be able to claim the ticket QR code off the NFT
・Use that QR code to enter our event while keeping or trading the collectible/artwork
ms.criteria:
On December 1st in partnership with NMKR and Nucast, customers will go to a mint page and mint their NFT with either FIAT currency into a custodial wallet, or cryptocurrency into their self custody wallet. These NFTs will be tradeable on the secondary market. Customers will then come to our website, be able to wallet connect and claim the VIP ticket entry QR code off of the NFT. The NFT artwork will then change to show that the ticket has been claimed off the NFT leaving the NFT as a collectible with artwork.
